focus: Logic flaws / auth / privilege / API security

new_validated_findings.title: Forged waitForInput registration hijacks or DoS-es suspended production runs (no hook_token binding)
evidence: backend/src/services/InputRequestService.ts:15-23 — registerInputRequest only requires runId in org; no ownership/status/hook_token binding
backend/src/services/InputRequestService.ts:79-107 — enqueueInputResume never compares suspension.hook_token to response token
backend/src/integrations/slack/inputRequests.ts:173 — button value embeds cleartext hook token in Slack blocks
packages/terse-cli/src/providers/typescript/runtimes/durableJobRuntime.ts:86-91 — wrong token fails only after claim (DoS); matching stolen token = full inject
backend/src/integrations/slack/inputRequestHandlers.ts:55-62 — any linked Slack workspace member may click
new_validated_findings.attack_path: Org member/project token → POST /sdk/input-request for a SUSPENDED production runId with attacker token → Slack click → worker claims suspension without hook_token check → wrong token fails CLI resume (DoS) OR steal T1 from legitimate button value via conversations.history and resume with attacker payload (full hijack).
new_validated_findings.why_new: Not in prior reported list; distinct from ApprovalService and test-run finalize / state put.

new_validated_findings.title: Project secrets allow dangerous runtime env overrides (NODE_OPTIONS etc.) into production sandboxes
evidence: backend/src/services/jobExecutors/SandboxJobExecutor.ts:92-110 — secrets merged into sandbox env; platform only overrides TERSE_*
new_validated_findings.attack_path: Member PUT secret NODE_OPTIONS=--require … → next production sandbox inherits it → code exec in sandbox with project secrets + sandbox API token, outside deploy audit trail.
new_validated_findings.why_new: Secret allowlist gap not previously filed.
